ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock edge to the controller's sequential process that updates ctrl and is forwarded to the cache memory instance clock input.
ports.evidence: ctrl_engine_sync sensitivity list and rising_edge(clk_i) and instance port map (clk_i => clk_i).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides asynchronous reset used to initialize ctrl fields on rstn_i='0' and is forwarded to the cache memory instance reset input.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branch in ctrl_engine_sync and instance port map (rstn_i => rstn_i).

ports.name: host_req_i
ports.functionality: Supplies all host request fields to the controller; the record is copied to bus_req_o by default and individual fields feed cache_o and the control logic.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr; cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data in ctrl_engine_comb.

ports.name: host_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the 32-bit address to compute tag/index and to drive cache_o.addr and bus_req_o.addr (default or overridden during downloads).
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c); cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr; bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write data from the host; forwarded into cache_o.data for writes and into bus_req_o.data when requests are forwarded to the bus.
ports.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data; bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb.

ports.name: host_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Provides byte-enable mask for host writes; used to set cache_o.we on writes and forwarded to bus_req_o.ben by default.
ports.evidence: cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben when write path; bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Signals a new host request; sets ctrl_nxt.buf_req and participates in conditions that move the FSM into lookup state.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; used in S_IDLE condition (host_req_i.stb = '1').

ports.name: host_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects read versus write handling in S_LOOKUP: read may complete from cache, write triggers cache writes or direct bus transactions.
ports.evidence: S_LOOKUP branches test host_req_i.rw to decide host_rsp_o.ack or set cache_o.we and bus_req_o.stb.

ports.name: host_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged into bus_req_o when the host request is copied to the bus; not otherwise inspected here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb.

ports.name: host_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Passed through into bus_req_o unchanged; not otherwise consumed by this entity.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: If asserted in S_IDLE it forces the controller to mark the request for direct forwarding (buf_dir); otherwise forwarded into bus_req_o.
ports.evidence: S_IDLE checks host_req_i.debug to set ctrl_nxt.buf_dir; bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: If set it marks the request for direct bus forwarding by setting buf_dir in S_IDLE and is forwarded to the bus request record.
ports.evidence: S_IDLE tests host_req_i.amo to set ctrl_nxt.buf_dir; bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged to bus_req_o as part of the forwarded host request; not inspected here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: host_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Initially forwarded into bus_req_o on record copy; for downloads the controller overrides lock to '1' when forming bus requests.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i then bus_req_o.lock <= '1' in DOWNLOAD_REQ.

ports.name: host_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Requests cache synchronization/clear: sets ctrl_nxt.buf_sync and triggers S_CLEAR when asserted, and is also forwarded in host request copy.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; S_IDLE checks host_req_i.fence to go to S_CLEAR.

ports.name: host_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Reports responses to the host: by default data is driven from cache_i.data and ack/err default '0'; in S_DIRECT_RSP the whole bus_rsp_i record is copied to host_rsp_o.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o. data <= cache_i.data default; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; other host_rsp_o field assignments in case arms.

ports.name: host_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Signals request completion to the host; defaults to '0', asserted for cache-hit reads, on download completion or when a direct bus response is copied.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.ack <= '0' default; host_rsp_o.ack <= '1' on cache hit and in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE when buf_err or when copying bus_rsp_i.

ports.name: host_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Reports errors to the host: default '0', set on download buffer error or when a direct bus response with err is forwarded.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.err <= '0' default; host_rsp_o.err <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE when ctrl.buf_err; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP.

ports.name: host_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Provides returned data to the host: by default from cache_i.data and in direct responses copied from bus_rsp_i.data.
role: forwards cache or bus data to host
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data default; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP.

ports.name: bus_req_o
ports.functionality: Carries a bus request to the external bus: default-copies host_req_i, but the controller overrides fields (addr, rw, stb, lock, fence) during clear and download sequences.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; bus_req_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in DOWNLOAD_REQ/RSP.

ports.name: bus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Set from the host request by default and overridden during downloads to the assembled address from ctrl.tag, ctrl.idx and ctrl.ofs (LSB '00').
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i and bus_req_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in DOWNLOAD_REQ/RSP.

ports.name: bus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries write data to the bus, forwarded from host_req_i.data by default.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb.

ports.name: bus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Forwarded from host_req_i.ben to the bus request record; used when the controller forwards writes.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Asserted by the controller to start external bus transactions; default '0' and set in LOOKUP, DIRECT and DOWNLOAD states when appropriate.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o.stb <= '0' default; set to '1' in S_LOOKUP (direct/write) and S_DOWNLOAD_REQ.

ports.name: bus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Forwarded from the host request by default; overridden by the controller to read ('0') during block-download requests.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; bus_req_o.rw <= '0' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ/RSP.

ports.name: bus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Forwarded from host_req_i.src unchanged into the outgoing bus request record.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged from host_req_i.priv into the bus request record.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged from host_req_i.debug into bus_req_o.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged from host_req_i.amo into the bus request record.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: Forwarded unchanged from host_req_i.amoop into the bus request record.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i.

ports.name: bus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Initially copied from host_req_i.lock; for block downloads the controller forces lock='1' on the bus request.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; bus_req_o.lock <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ/RSP.

ports.name: bus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Asserted by the controller during S_CLEAR (if READ_ONLY=false) to issue bus fence; otherwise part of forwarded host_req_i.
ports.evidence: S_CLEAR sets bus_req_o.fence <= '1' (conditional on READ_ONLY); bus_req_o <= host_req_i otherwise.

ports.name: bus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Carries responses from the external bus into the controller; used for direct responses (copied to host_rsp_o) and for downloads (data/ack/err feed cache logic).
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err.

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Indicates completion of a bus transaction; used to advance the FSM (direct response completion and download word progression).
ports.evidence: If (bus_rsp_i.ack = '1') then ctrl_nxt.state <= S_IDLE in S_DIRECT_RSP; DOWNLOAD_RSP increments ctrl_nxt.ofs on ack.

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Signals bus transfer errors; ORed into ctrl_nxt.buf_err during downloads and forwarded to host in direct responses.
role: propagated into buffer error and host response
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP.

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries data from bus responses into the controller; used to supply cache_o.data during downloads and forwarded to the host on direct responses.
ports.evidence: cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides the reset condition used by the status_memory process; when '0' it forces valid_mem and valid_mem_rd to their reset values in the reset branch of that process.
ports.evidence: status_memory process sensitivity and reset branch: if (rstn_i = '0') then valid_mem/valid_mem_rd set (reset).

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Clocks the three sequential processes; rising_edge(clk_i) sequences updates to valid_mem and valid_mem_rd, tag_mem and tag_mem_rd, and the data memories and rdata_o.
role: clock for status, tag and data processes
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) appears in status_memory, tag_memory and data_memory processes.

ports.name: clr_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at the clock edge inside status_memory, it forces valid_mem to all '0's, overriding per-index updates and other write conditions.
ports.evidence: status_memory: if (clr_i = '1') then valid_mem <= (others => '0');

ports.name: inv_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at the clock edge inside status_memory, it clears the valid_mem bit at acc_idx, overriding normal updates for that index.
ports.evidence: status_memory: elsif (inv_i = '1') then valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '0';

ports.name: new_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at the clock edge, it sets the valid_mem bit at acc_idx and writes acc_tag into tag_mem at acc_idx, enabling new-line installation logic.
role: enable for installing new cache line
ports.evidence: status_memory and tag_memory: elsif (new_i = '1') then valid_mem(...) <= '1'; tag_mem(...) <= acc_tag;

ports.name: hit_o
ports.functionality: Combinationally reports a hit when valid_mem_rd = '1' and the sampled tag (tag_mem_rd) equals acc_tag; it exports the internal hit decision.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment: hit_o <= '1' when (valid_mem_rd = '1') and (tag_mem_rd = acc_tag) else '0';

ports.name: addr_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the external 32-bit address which is sliced to produce acc_tag, acc_idx and acc_off; those fields drive tag/index/offset logic inside the entity.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignments: acc_tag <= addr_i(...); acc_idx <= addr_i(...); acc_off <= addr_i(...).

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: Per-bit write-enable signals gate writes to each data_mem_bX byte at acc_adr on the rising clock; each bit enables its corresponding byte write.
ports.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(0)='1') then data_mem_b0(...) <= ...; similarly for we_i(1..3).

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies 32-bit write data whose byte slices are written into data_mem_b0..b3 at acc_adr when corresponding we_i bits are set at the clock edge.
ports.evidence: data_memory: data_mem_b0(...) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); etc., inside rising_edge when corresponding we_i bit is '1'.

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: Registers and outputs the assembled 32-bit word composed of bytes read from data_mem_b0..b3 at acc_adr on the rising clock, making memory contents available externally.
ports.evidence: data_memory (rising_edge): rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(...); rdata_o(15 downto 8) <= data_mem_b1(...); etc.

signals.name: cache_o
signals.functionality: Aggregates cache commands, address, data and write-enable mask driven by the controller and forwards them to the cache memory instance ports.
signals.evidence: cache_o.* assigned in ctrl_engine_comb and connected in instance port map.

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_clr
signals.functionality: Asserted in the S_CLEAR arm to command cache memory clear; defaulted to '0' otherwise and forwarded to cache instance clr_i.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_clr <= '0' default and cache_o.cmd_clr <= '1' in S_CLEAR; port map clr_i => cache_o.cmd_clr.

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_inv
signals.functionality: Asserted on download error to invalidate the newly downloaded line and forwarded to the cache instance inv_i.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_inv <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE when ctrl.buf_err = '1'; port map inv_i => cache_o.cmd_inv.

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_new
signals.functionality: Asserted during block-download request (S_DOWNLOAD_REQ) to signal the memory instance that a new cache line will be written, forwarded to new_i.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_new <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ; port map new_i => cache_o.cmd_new.

signals.name: cache_o.addr
signals.functionality: Carries the 32-bit address either taken from the host request or constructed from ctrl.tag/idx/ofs during downloads, and forwards it to the cache memory addr_i.
signals.evidence: cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr default; cache_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ; port map addr_i => cache_o.addr.

signals.name: cache_o.data
signals.functionality: Holds write data either from the host or from bus responses during downloads and forwards it to the cache memory write-data input.
signals.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data default; cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; port map wdata_i => cache_o.data.

signals.name: cache_o.we
signals.functionality: Carries the byte-enable mask for writes: set from host_req_i.ben for host writes and to all-ones during downloads; forwarded to the cache memory we_i.
signals.evidence: cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben for host write path; cache_o.we <= (others => '1') in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; port map we_i => cache_o.we.

signals.name: cache_i
signals.functionality: Collects hit and read-data outputs from the cache memory instance and provides them to the controller logic (hit tests and host data).
role: supplies hit and read data to controller
signals.evidence: instance port map rdata_o => cache_i.data, hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit; cache_i.data used as host_rsp_o.data default.

signals.name: cache_i.sta_hit
signals.functionality: Reflects the cache memory hit output and is tested by the controller to choose hit paths (read return) or miss/download paths.
signals.evidence: cache_i.sta_hit is used in S_LOOKUP condition to choose hit vs miss; port map hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit.

signals.name: cache_i.data
signals.functionality: Carries read data produced by the cache memory and is used as the default host response data when a cache hit occurs.
role: forwards memory read data to host
signals.evidence: port map rdata_o => cache_i.data; host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data in ctrl_engine_comb.

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds the FSM state and buffered request/address fields across clock edges; updated from ctrl_nxt on rising clock and cleared on reset.
signals.evidence: clked process ctrl_engine_sync: on rising_edge(clk_i) ctrl <= ctrl_nxt; reset branch assigns ctrl fields.

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.functionality: Holds the current controller state across cycles and is used as the case selector in ctrl_engine_comb to choose outputs and next-state assignments.
signals.evidence: case ctrl.state is ... in ctrl_engine_comb assigns cache_o.*, host_rsp_o, bus_req_o and ctrl_nxt.state per state.

signals.name: ctrl.buf_req
signals.functionality: Latched request indicator held across cycles; set by host_req_i.stb and used to enter the lookup state when present.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; S_IDLE checks ctrl.buf_req to go to S_LOOKUP.

signals.name: ctrl.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Latched fence/sync request; when set causes the FSM to go to S_CLEAR to issue a fence/clear operation.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; S_IDLE checks ctrl.buf_sync to go to S_CLEAR.

signals.name: ctrl.buf_err
signals.functionality: Accumulates transfer errors across downloads (ORed with bus_rsp_i.err) and, when set at download completion, causes invalidation and a host error response.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; S_DOWNLOAD_DONE checks ctrl.buf_err to invalidate and set host_rsp_o.err.

signals.name: ctrl.buf_dir
signals.functionality: Latched qualifier indicating that the current request must be directly forwarded to the bus (bypassing cache) and used to select the direct-response path.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' in S_IDLE when address/amo/debug conditions; S_LOOKUP tests ctrl.buf_dir to start direct bus transaction.

signals.name: ctrl.tag
signals.functionality: Holds the extracted tag bits captured during lookup and supplies tag bits when forming bus and cache addresses during downloads.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c) in S_LOOKUP; ctrl.tag is used to form addresses in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ.

signals.name: ctrl.idx
signals.functionality: Holds the extracted index bits captured during lookup and supplies index bits when assembling addresses for downloads.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr((offset_size_c+2+index_size_c)-1 downto offset_size_c+2) in S_LOOKUP; used in DOWNLOAD_REQ.

signals.name: ctrl.ofs
signals.functionality: Holds the current word offset within a cache block during downloads, is incremented on bus_rsp_i.ack and used to form addresses until download completion.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.ofs <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(ctrl.ofs) + 1) on bus_rsp_i.ack in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; and_reduce_f(ctrl.ofs) used to decide S_DOWNLOAD_DONE.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt
signals.functionality: Holds combinational next-state and next control values computed from current ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i and bus_rsp_i; captured into ctrl on the clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_comb computes ctrl_nxt.* from ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i, bus_rsp_i; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on rising edge.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.state
signals.functionality: Computed from current state, host request fields, cache hit and bus responses inside the comb process and then captured into ctrl.state on clock edge.
signals.evidence: case ctrl.state is ... assigns ctrl_nxt.state based on host_req_i, cache_i.sta_hit and bus_rsp_i.ack in ctrl_engine_comb.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_req
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for buf_req derived from the current buf_req or host_req_i.stb and later captured into ctrl.buf_req.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb in ctrl_engine_comb; captured by ctrl_engine_sync.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Combinationally set from ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence and then captured into ctrl.buf_sync.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence in ctrl_engine_comb; captured on rising edge.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_err
signals.functionality: Combines the existing buffered error with bus_rsp_i.err during downloads and is captured into ctrl.buf_err.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; captured by ctrl_engine_sync.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from host request address range, host_req_i.amo or host_req_i.debug in S_IDLE and captured into ctrl.buf_dir for next cycles.
signals.evidence: S_IDLE sets ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' when address range/amo/debug conditions hold; ctrl captures ctrl_nxt.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.tag
signals.functionality: Combinationally loaded from host_req_i.addr during lookup and then captured into ctrl.tag for use during downloads.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c) in S_LOOKUP; captured by ctrl_engine_sync.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.idx
signals.functionality: Combinationally loaded from host_req_i.addr slices during lookup and captured into ctrl.idx for subsequent download address formation.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr((offset_size_c+2+index_size_c)-1 downto offset_size_c+2) in S_LOOKUP; captured at clock.

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.ofs
signals.functionality: Set combinationally to zero in lookup, incremented in DOWNLOAD_RSP when bus_rsp_i.ack='1', and captured into ctrl.ofs to step through block words.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.ofs <= (others => '0') in S_LOOKUP; ctrl_nxt.ofs <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(ctrl.ofs) + 1) when bus_rsp_i.ack in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP.

signals.name: valid_mem
signals.functionality: Holds one validity bit per block and is updated on reset, on clr_i (all cleared), inv_i (indexed clear) and new_i (indexed set); its indexed value is read into valid_mem_rd.
signals.evidence: status_memory assigns valid_mem in reset/branches and then sets valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))).

signals.name: valid_mem_rd
signals.function: sampled valid bit for current index
signals.functionality: Captures the selected valid_mem bit at the clock edge (and reset), and supplies the validity test used by the hit comparator that drives hit_o.
signals.evidence: status_memory: valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))); hit_o uses (valid_mem_rd = '1') in its when guard.

signals.name: tag_mem
signals.functionality: Stores acc_tag into the indexed entry on new_i at the clock edge and provides entries to tag_mem_rd for hit comparison.
signals.evidence: tag_memory process: if (new_i = '1') then tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= acc_tag; tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))).

signals.name: tag_mem_rd
signals.functionality: Captures the tag_mem entry at the selected index on the clock edge and supplies the sampled tag to the hit comparator (compared with acc_tag).
signals.evidence: tag_memory: tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))); hit_o compares tag_mem_rd to acc_tag.

signals.name: data_mem_b0
signals.functionality: At the clock edge, writes wdata_i(7 downto 0) into the indexed byte when we_i(0) is '1', and supplies that byte to rdata_o(7 downto 0) on reads.
role: provides low byte for read output
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(0)='1') then data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b1
signals.functionality: At the clock edge, writes wdata_i(15 downto 8) into the indexed byte when we_i(1) is '1', and supplies that byte to rdata_o(15 downto 8) on reads.
role: provides second byte for read output
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(1)='1') then data_mem_b1(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(15 downto 8); rdata_o(15 downto 8) <= data_mem_b1(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b2
signals.functionality: At the clock edge, writes wdata_i(23 downto 16) into the indexed byte when we_i(2) is '1', and supplies that byte to rdata_o(23 downto 16) on reads.
role: provides third byte for read output
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(2)='1') then data_mem_b2(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(23 downto 16); rdata_o(23 downto 16) <= data_mem_b2(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b3
signals.functionality: At the clock edge, writes wdata_i(31 downto 24) into the indexed byte when we_i(3) is '1', and supplies that byte to rdata_o(31 downto 24) on reads.
role: provides high byte for read output
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(3)='1') then data_mem_b3(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(31 downto 24); rdata_o(31 downto 24) <= data_mem_b3(...).

signals.name: acc_tag
signals.functionality: Carries the tag slice extracted from addr_i, is forwarded into tag_mem when new_i writes occur, and is compared with tag_mem_rd for the hit decision.
role: source for tag writes and comparator input
signals.evidence: concurrent: acc_tag <= addr_i(31 downto 31-(tag_size_c-1)); used by tag_memory (tag_mem <= acc_tag) and by hit_o comparator.

signals.name: acc_idx
signals.functionality: Carries index bits from addr_i, selects entries in valid_mem and tag_mem via to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx)), and forms part of acc_adr through concatenation.
signals.evidence: concurrent: acc_idx <= addr_i(...); used as to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx)) indexing valid_mem and tag_mem; acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off.

signals.name: acc_off
signals.functionality: Carries block offset bits from addr_i and participates in acc_adr concatenation, contributing to the byte address used to index the data memories.
signals.evidence: concurrent: acc_off <= addr_i(2+(offset_size_c-1) downto 2); acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off.

signals.name: acc_adr
signals.functionality: Is formed by concatenating acc_idx and acc_off (acc_idx & acc_off) and is used to index the byte-addressable data memories for reads and writes.
signals.evidence: concurrent: acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off; data_memory uses data_mem_bX(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) for reads/writes.
